blockers.description: Missing required assets that block progress and should not be marked placeholder-complete.

items.title: Original Unity sprite/texture assets not present in repository
items.description: The repository contains only parsed fixture JSON (metadata, GUIDs, hierarchy) from Unity prefabs and scenes. The actual .png sprite files, Spine .skel/.atlas files, and .asset files referenced by the manifest are NOT included in the repository. These reside in the external DreamDeveloperGame-Crossover Unity project.
items.impact: Frontend currently uses CSS-only dark theme styling with no raster sprites. Building sprite rendering, hero portraits, and item icons all require the original PNG/Spine assets. Cannot implement visual parity without sourcing these files.
items.resolution: Extract required .png sprites from DreamDeveloperGame-Crossover/Assets/Sprites/ and Spine data from Assets/Spines/Heroes/. Copy into frontend/src/assets/ as build inputs.

items.title: Spine runtime integration not configured for web
items.description: The frontend declares a spine-bridge.ts contract (ISpineBridge interface) but has no actual Spine WebGL runtime integration configured. The SkeletonData.asset files are Unity-native .asset format, incompatible with web Spine runtimes.
items.impact: Hero character rendering in HeroDetailScreen cannot use the original Spine animations until Spine runtime is integrated and asset format conversion is addressed.
items.resolution: 1) Add spine-player or @esotericsoftware/spine-webgl npm package. 2) Configure asset pipeline to export Spine data from Unity in .json/.skel format. 3) Wire ISpineBridge to actual Spine renderer.

items.title: GUID-to-asset-path resolution requires Unity source project
items.description: GUIDs extracted from prefab JSON (e.g., '87a55679f12a1e6489ecdb1d6e6f6b93' for building_perception_tower.png) are Unity-internal identifiers. These map to asset paths within the Unity project's .meta files. Without the Unity source project available at build time, GUIDs serve as documentation cross-references only — the actual asset files must be identified by path.
items.impact: Asset pipeline cannot resolve GUID → file path automatically. Manual path-based asset extraction from the Unity project is required.
items.resolution: Maintain the path-based references in this manifest. The actual asset extraction is a manual/copy step from the original Unity project, not an automated resolution.
